**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: DENY**

**Service:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644)  
**Order Date:** April 16, 2025

---

**CRITERIA REVIEW**

**BMI Requirement – MET**  
Current BMI of 35.0 kg/m² meets the minimum threshold of ≥35 kg/m² (documented 3/27/2025).

**Prior Conservative Treatment – MET**  
Patient completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian involvement and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful (doc-004).

**Procedure Type – MET**  
Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is a covered procedure.

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities – NOT MET**  
This criterion is not satisfied. The bariatric surgery consultation note (4/5/2025, 11 days prior to order) explicitly documents: "No obesity-related comorbidities identified: blood pressure normal, HbA1c 5.3%, sleep study negative for apnea, lipids normal, no joint disease."

Policy requires at least one obesity-related comorbidity (such as hypertension, type 2 diabetes, obstructive sleep apnea, dyslipidemia, or obesity-related joint disease). While the patient has other chronic conditions on record, these do not meet the obesity-related comorbidity requirement.

---

**TO PROCEED:** Provide updated clinical documentation demonstrating an obesity-related comorbidity meeting policy criteria.
